text:
Asha (Marketing): Quick kickoff  we need a short battlecard vs Cloud AI + LLM APIs + infra vendors, plus a webinar 8-min hook. Tight: ship v0 in 4 days. Who takes what? :clock1:
Tom (Product): Ill own technical claims and the SLA phrasing. Will post draft bullets in 6h.
Priya (Growth): I'll draft 3 webinar hooks and 2 email subject lines. Prefer an econ-first angle.
Carlos (Sales): Field asks: procurement-ready lines for T&C, migration effort, and a "why not build" rebuttal. Need short procurement script.
Dana (Field): I can run the SDR subject test and prep 2 one-liners: econ + migration-smooth.
Ben (DevEx): I have a microbench we can safe-quote. Note: synthetic lab, not customer traffic.
Tom (Product): Draft claim candidates (v0.1):
- Lower predictable tail-costs with workload-aware batching + KV prefix reuse.
- One API, three deployment modes: hosted, reserved GPU pools, private VPC.
- Automated fallback routing to model/backfill variants to preserve availability.
Priya (Growth): Webinar hooks (short):
- "Inference cost that scales with your product, not your bills"
- "Avoid downtime when the cloud chokes: graceful fallbacks you can rely on"
- "From dev to prod: same API, fewer surprises"
Priya (Growth): Subjects to test:
- "Cut inference spend without code rewrite"
- "Keep latency predictable under load"
Carlos (Sales): Procurement-ready snippets: 
- Data residency: "Private deployment + KMS + audit logs. We can scope regionized installs."
- SLA: "Dedicated pools + contractual uptime/latency SLOs; escalation runbook."
- Migration: "Model pinning + API compatibility layer to reduce client-side changes."
Dana (Field): One-liners for SDRs:
A) "Slash inference spend up to 50% with batch-aware serving and caching."
B) "Same API across cloud, dedicated, and on-prem  cut integration work."
Ben (DevEx): Microbench (label: synthetic, lab conditions):
```
p95 latency (chat-like prompt): Redwood-hosted 70ms | Vendor-A 200ms
sustained throughput (dedicated): Redwood-dedicated 2.8k toks/s | Vendor-A 900 toks/s
note: quantized model on A100; small token size for parity
```
Ben (DevEx): Will add methodology note (prompt shapes, batch sizes, seed) to doc.
legal-bot: Reminder: avoid definitive "we are faster" claims without verification; use "observed" or "in lab" qualifiers.
Asha (Marketing): Good call. Use safe language: "observed in internal benchmarks" + link to methodology.
Tom (Product): I'll convert the three claims into one-liners for the battlecard and a short paragraph for the playbook.
Priya (Growth): I'll pick the webinar title by EOD and draft a 1-slide hook + CTA.
Dana (Field): I'll run SDR test tomorrow AM and report conversion delta.
Carlos (Sales): I'll draft procurement Q&A and hand it to legal for quick review.
Asha (Marketing): Next steps (timeline):
- 24h: Tom one-liners + Ben adds methodology
- 48h: Priya webinar title + slide + email subjects
- 72h: Dana SDR A/B results; Carlos procurement doc to legal
- 96h: marketing compiles battlecard v0.1, circulate for approval
Asha (Marketing): Thanks all  sync 15m tomorrow to sign off. :rocket:
